_comment: Development ingest auth snapshot for the single-node/evaluation stack
The bearer token is public on purpose: 'observaki-local-dev-token'.
Never reuse this snapshot or token outside a local evaluation stack;
staging/production snapshots are signed (AD-19) and rotated by the control plane.
expires_at is far in the future so the stack keeps working without a
regeneration step; quota (100k events/s) is per tenant, before sampling.
